fields.acceptance: A testscript with fixture journals of a run blocked on a question, a run waiting at sign-off, a failed run, a run interrupted again after a daemon resume and a done run lists exactly the first four in order in text and --json; once the question is answered, the sign-off approved, the given-up run abandoned and a new fake run started and finished on the failed run's change set, rhiza inbox says nothing waits and lists no failed run for the abandoned one.
fields.statement: rhiza inbox lists, oldest first across every run of the repo, each item waiting on the owner with a short item ID: a question (its run, change set, session tab and the question), a run waiting at sign-off, a failed run (its failed step and detail, until it is retried with rhiza run resume --retry or a newer run starts on its change set), and a run the daemon gave up on (interrupted again after the daemon's one resume, its step, until it is resumed or abandoned), in text and --json, and says so when nothing waits. A run failed by rhiza run abandon is the owner's own act and is never listed as a failed run.
